playbooks.intent: Identify BPFDoor ICMP shell or heartbeat traffic using the family-specific ICMP structure rather than a coincidental payload substring.
playbooks.known_false_positive_risk: Ordinary ping filler can contain X: by chance and set the shared ET.bpfdoor state bit; the signature family was deactivated pending false-positive-safe tuning.

required_predicates.reason: The BPFDoor heartbeat reply discriminator is the invalid ICMP code 1; ordinary echo replies use code 0.

supporting_predicates.reason: The documented BPFDoor ICMP shell uses the hardcoded sequence value 1234.

marker_predicates.reason: A command marker must appear at the expected structural offset; X: at arbitrary offsets in random ping data is not sufficient.

confidence_limiters: Do not attribute BPFDoor when the required heartbeat code is absent.
A coincidental X: byte pair at a variable payload offset is evidence against a stable command marker.
Endpoint process, persistence, binary, or BPF telemetry is required before a malicious attribution can be high confidence.
